verdict: Paid ads have been dark for 10 days; restart is the priority this week.
narrative: Both Meta and Google have had zero spend since September 18 — 10 consecutive days with no paid activity and no new leads from either channel. Over the full 28-day window, Meta delivered all 90 leads at $16.09 per lead, while Google spent $361.52 with no conversions recorded; that Google budget is being reviewed and reallocated before campaigns resume. Paid ads are being reactivated this week, and several overdue build milestones — including landing pages and creative — are being closed out to ensure the restart launches on a stronger foundation. Once spend resumes, you should see leads return to the pace established in the first half of this period.
